description: This file implements video handling functionalities for the Wesnoth game, including video mode setup, surface management, screen updates, and a test program for rendering pixels using SDL.

classes.name: CVideo
classes.description: Class managing video modes, surfaces, and rendering updates using SDL.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the video mode with specified resolution, bits per pixel, and flags.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Updates the display with the current buffer, either flipping or updating specific rects.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the video surface for direct pixel access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the video surface after direct pixel access.

methods.name: getx
methods.description: Returns the width of the video surface.

methods.name: gety
methods.description: Returns the height of the video surface.

methods.name: getBitsPerPixel
methods.description: Returns the bits per pixel of the current video mode.

methods.name: set_help_string
methods.description: Displays a help string overlay on the screen.

methods.name: clear_help_string
methods.description: Removes the specified help string overlay.
